thesis: StandardAero, Inc. memiliki fundamental cukup (skor 53/100) dengan keunggulan utama di pertumbuhan (69) dan valuasi (66). Titik lemahnya ada di kualitas bisnis (30). Gabungan model DCF, multiple sektor, dan target analis menghasilkan nilai wajar $26.66 — potensi turun 3.7% dalam ~12 bulan (keyakinan rendah). Kondisi teknikal lemah (49/100). Risiko geopolitik rendah; berpeluang diuntungkan tema Rusia–Ukraina & Belanja Pertahanan.

cons.text: Lonjakan laba sangat besar (+72%) — bila bisnisnya siklikal, P/E rendah di puncak siklus bisa menyesatkan; proyeksi berisiko terlalu optimistis.
Harga sudah 4% di atas estimasi nilai wajar ($26.66).
Simulasi: 33% kemungkinan harga turun >20% dalam 12 bulan (volatilitas 45%/thn).
Short interest 13.7% dari float — banyak investor bertaruh harga turun.

pros.text: Laba per saham (EPS) diproyeksikan naik 72% — dari $1.05 ke $1.81.
PEG ratio 0.26 — pertumbuhan laba belum sepenuhnya tercermin di harga (GARP: Growth at Reasonable Price).
Piotroski F-Score 9/9 — fundamental membaik di hampir semua indikator (laba, arus kas, leverage, efisiensi).

Diuntungkan tema geopolitik Rusia–Ukraina & Belanja Pertahanan (intensitas 45/100): Perang di Eropa Timur mendorong anggaran pertahanan NATO, keamanan energi, dan harga komoditas (gas, pupuk, gandum).
P/E forward 15.3x — 18% lebih murah dari median sektor Industri (18.7x).
14 analis Wall Street, konsensus Buy dengan target rata-rata $34.17 (+23%).

summary: StandardAero, Inc. provides aerospace engine aftermarket services for fixed and rotary wing aircraft in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Rest of Europe, Asia, and internationally. It operates in two segments, Engine Services and Component Repair Services. The Engine Services segment provides a suite of aftermarket services, including maintenance, repair and overhaul, on-wing and field service support, asset management, and engineering and related solutions to customers in the commercial aerospace, military and helicopter, and business aviation end markets.
